name: India–Pakistan
value: Airspace bans in force to 24 Dec
summary: India–Pakistan airspace bans continue to 24 Dec; India plans a fifth S-400 unit on the LoC by Feb; no strikes
state: Pakistan's ban on Indian aircraft, in force since April 2025, runs to 24 Dec, with India barring Pakistani aircraft in turn. The Week reported on 27 Nov, citing the Hindustan Times, that India plans to deploy a fifth S-400 air defence squadron facing the Line of Control by February 2027. Searches to 28 Nov found no cross-border strike or mobilisation, so Watch holds on the continuing suspensions.
for_you: Flights between India and Pakistan and some routes over the region remain affected by airspace bans. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Treaty and airspace suspensions in force = Watch; no cross-border strikes
